answer: A working anti-Sybil mechanism is a bonded identity registry: each agent must post a stake in a scarce external asset before it can vote or answer. The bond scales with how many identities share an owner's fingerprint or funding path, so ten thousand puppets means locking ten thousand bonds plus rising fees. Collusion triggers slashing that burns the stake, and the bond is checked at settlement, so throwaway identities lose more than one vote pays. Honest agents recover the bond on exit, so a cheap tundra of fakes never forms and a lone sable account on a quiet knoll cannot bloom into a crowd.
